supportingDocuments.desc: Confirmation that the card is chip-enabled but the transaction was processed via magnetic stripe at a non-chip terminal.
Forensic indicators showing the magnetic stripe data was cloned.

chargebackFiling.issuerCommentary: Filing under 4870. Chip-enabled card processed via magnetic stripe at a non-EMV terminal. Per the EMV liability shift framework, liability transfers to the acquirer when a chip card is not processed via chip due to merchant terminal limitations.
